name: Pica Complex
source:
Today, Rory must visit her psychiatrist, Miss Brenton. After an argument during their last session, she's hesitant to return to that blue living room. 

By the time she leaves, she will be a different person.

[From [url=https://sepulturegirl.itch.io/pica-complex]itch.io[/url]]
